rationale: Residual worm tissue modeled as ICRU four-element soft tissue rather than pure water.
Nerve-rich compartment modeled with ICRP brain material as closest radiological proxy for neural tissue.
Body wall muscle modeled with ICRP skeletal muscle material.
Digestive/intestine modeled as ICRP soft tissue proxy; C. elegans intestine stores lipids/glycogen and macromolecules but no complete tissue-specific elemental table is available.
Germline/reproductive compartment modeled with ICRP testes material as germ-cell-rich proxy.
Excretory canal/cell compartment modeled as water-rich soft tissue proxy; chemistry stage remains water radiolysis.
